Class StatementParameters2

java.lang.Object
com.mcpdbwizard.pub.StatementParameters2
Direct Known Subclasses:
CallableStatementParameters, DmlStatement
public class StatementParameters2 extends Object
A set of parameters for a PreparedStatement or CallableStatement

This class is used to represent IN parameters for a SQL statement or PL/SQL Procedure.

This class supercedes an older class called 'statementParameters.java', which has been retired. MCPDBWizard generated code now uses StatementParameters2.java.

Under normal circumstances MCPDBWizard users will have no reason to use this class directly - the generated code will use it.

    • setParam

      public void setParam(int parameterId, Date parameterValue) throws CSException
      Set a parameter
      Parameters:
      parameterId - The id of the parameter to set. Id's start at 0.
      parameterValue - A java.util.date parameter. We ignore nanoseconds. This is because DATE is stored with a precision of 1 second but can be searched with nanosecond precison. If you don't always drop the nanosecond portion you can create records which you can't find.
      Throws:
      CSException - if parameterId is not a valid parameter.
      Since:
      4.0.2016 Support for java.util.Date added.

    • setVectorBinaryParam

      public void setVectorBinaryParam(int parameterId, byte[] parameterValue) throws CSException
      A convenience method to set a binary (bit-packed) Oracle VECTOR (23ai) parameter. Distinct from an ordinary RAW byte[] bind: this marks the parameter as OracleTypes.VECTOR_BINARY so bindParameters binds it as a binary vector rather than RAW (a byte[] is ambiguous between the two).
      Parameters:
      parameterId - The id of the parameter to set. Id's start at 0.
      parameterValue - The packed vector bytes (n bits = n/8 bytes), or null.
      Throws:
      CSException - if parameterId is not a valid parameter.
      Since:
      Oracle 23ai

    • setVectorSparseParam

      public void setVectorSparseParam(int parameterId, SparseVector parameterValue) throws CSException
      A convenience method to set a sparse Oracle VECTOR (23ai) parameter. The SparseVector is bound through the generic OracleType.VECTOR carrying an oracle.sql.VECTOR sparse value (there is no VECTOR_SPARSE bind type); the SparseVector→oracle.sql.VECTOR conversion happens in bindParameters. Distinct from setVectorBinaryParam(int, byte[]) (byte[]) and the dense double[] path.
      Parameters:
      parameterId - The id of the parameter to set. Id's start at 0.
      parameterValue - The sparse vector, or null.
      Throws:
      CSException - if parameterId is not a valid parameter.
      Since:
      Oracle 23ai

    • setNativeBooleanParam

      public void setNativeBooleanParam(int parameterId, Boolean parameterValue) throws CSException
      A convenience method to set a native ISO-SQL BOOLEAN (23ai) parameter. Distinct from setParam(int, Boolean), which is used for the older PL/SQL boolean convention (passed across JDBC as a number).
      Parameters:
      parameterId - The id of the parameter to set. Id's start at 0.
      parameterValue - A native boolean.
      Throws:
      CSException - if parameterId is not a valid parameter.
      Since:
      Oracle 23ai
